crossRefs.note: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be…
The children of Israel said to Yahweh, “We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems good to you; only deliver us, please…
The king said, “What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Because he curses, and because Yahweh has said to him…
He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. Yahweh gave, and Yahweh has taken away.…
But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God…
I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.
Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, “Yahweh’s word which you have spoken is good.” He said moreover, “For there will be peace…
Why does a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Samuel told him every bit, and hid nothing from him. He said, “It is Yahweh. Let him do what seems good to him.”
translations.bsb: So Samuel told him everything and did not hide a thing from him. “He is the LORD,” replied Eli. “Let Him do what is good in His eyes.”
translations.kjv: And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It is the LORD: let him do what seemeth him good.
translations.asv: And Samuel told him every whit, and hid nothing from him. And he said, It is Jehovah: let him do what seemeth him good.
